channel.title: Early Trends
channel.description: New early-trend product picks from Early Trends. Free RSS; no account required.

item.title: Trend of the Week: Saie SuperSuede Baked Eyeshadow
item.description: Trend of the Week for the week of November 10, 2026: Saie SuperSuede Baked Eyeshadow. Line launch August 18, 2026. Bellini, a rose-gold shimmer co-created with Hannah Chody, sold out within hours on October 15. Trend age about 2.8 months. Label: Early. Passes the mainstream filter. Bellini was not on the Amazon shade list; the buy link is the line listing.

item.title: Squeeze Please Scented Marshmallow 3-Pack
item.description: PlayMonster Squeeze Please Scented Marshmallow 3-Pack, an Amazon-exclusive scented marshmallow squishy. TDmonthly on October 22, 2026 reported it at No. 27 in Toys and No. 2 in Toys New Releases. A needoh alternative when NeeDoh is sold out. Identified on November 11, 2026. Label: Early. See current price on Amazon.

item.title: Emotional Support Pals x NFL
item.description: Relatable Emotional Support Pals x NFL, an Amazon-exclusive plush football line in 12 team sets. The parent Emotional Support Pals brand already exists; this pick is the NFL line. Preorders began September 1, 2026. Identified on November 11, 2026. Label: Early. See current price on Amazon.

item.title: Sony MDR-3R USB-C Wired On-Ear Headphones
item.description: Sony MDR-3R USB-C wired on-ear headphones, announced November 5, 2026. Label: Early. Replaces FiiO DM13 in Tech & Gadgets. Where to buy is the silver Amazon listing. See current price on Amazon.

item.title: Saie SuperSuede Baked Eyeshadow
item.description: Saie SuperSuede Baked Eyeshadow, baked eyeshadow singles. The line launched August 18, 2026. Bellini, a rose-gold shimmer co-created with Hannah Chody, sold out within hours on October 15, 2026. Identified on November 10, 2026. Label: Early. Trend age about 2.8 months. Bellini was not on the Amazon shade list; Where to buy is the line's Amazon listing. See current price on Amazon.

item.title: Schylling NeeDoh Nice Ice Baby
item.description: Schylling NeeDoh Nice Ice Baby, a 1.25-inch squishy cube on Amazon. Restockd tracked about 83 Amazon restocks in 30 days, latest around November 3–4, 2026. Identified on November 4, 2026. Relabelled November 7, 2026: already mainstream, not an early pick. Now a case study.

item.title: HOZO NeoSander
item.description: HOZO NeoSander, a palm-sized detail sander. Kickstarter opened January 20, 2026; the June 11, 2026 retail note says more than $2 million from over 14,000 backers. Amazon listing sold by HOZO. Identified on October 31, 2026 (2026-10-31). Stage at identification: Early–mid.

item.title: InvisOutlet Aura
item.description: Intecular InvisOutlet Aura, an in-wall outlet with a color night light. Kickstarter funded in 22 minutes on August 19, 2025. Brand shop still out of stock on October 31, 2026; Amazon listing sold by Intecular was in stock. Identified on October 31, 2026 (2026-10-31). Stage at identification: Early–mid.

item.title: Made In carbon steel griddle
item.description: Made In carbon steel griddle set on Amazon. Replaces Sabre Paris Bistrot flatware, which had no single Amazon product page. Identified on October 28, 2026 (2026-10-28). Stage at identification: Early.
